dct_description_sm: The dataset was collected to examine the differences between vegetation communities in soil gas profiles.  Patterns of greenhouse gas concentrations in soil atmospheres reflect processes of consumption and production of these gases, especially by soil microorganisms.  These processes are also responsible for soil surface effluxes of greenhouse gases.  The examined vegetation communities at the polar oasis at Alexandra Fiord are representative of communities found across large areas throughout the Arctic, thus this study provides insight into the different contributions to greenhouse gas emissions of a range of important vegetation communities.
dct_title_s: Soil gas profiles in 6 Arctic vegetation communities
